children: Otto Alexander, a Director, reported sales of Curbline Properties common stock on August 27, 28 and 31, 2026. The transactions were sales executed at weighted-average prices of $30.00, $30.11 and $30.05 per share, respectively. The total proceeds from the three sales were $3,439,615. Otto Alexander directly owns 6,808,282 shares of common stock following these transactions.
